Payroll Register Troubleshooting

What it does
- Helps support staff diagnose issues with payroll register reporting.
- Provides troubleshooting steps for filter and export problems.

Common issues
- No payroll runs appear.
- The export button does not download a CSV.
- Payroll totals look incorrect.

Troubleshooting steps
1. Confirm the pay date range covers payroll run pay dates.
2. Confirm the selected company is active and assigned to payroll runs.
3. Use the All companies option to verify whether data exists across companies.
4. If the report shows runs but the CSV download is empty, reload the page and click Export CSV again.
5. If totals look wrong, confirm payroll run totals have been calculated and saved before report generation.

Permissions
- Support users need read access to payroll reports and company payroll data.

Payroll cautions
- This report does not expose full SSNs or bank account numbers.
- The report relies on stored payroll run totals for accuracy.
